			DA_has_Energy_power_or_higher = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 
				DA_own_copper_provinces = { amount = 15 }
				DA_own_damestear_provinces = { amount = 15 }
				OR = {
					NOT = { DA_own_copper_provinces = { amount = 30 } }
					NOT = { DA_own_damestear_provinces = { amount = 30 } }
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = DA_own_15_malus_tt
			DA_apply_Metal = {
				DA_unit = SHIP
				DA_Cost = 1
				DA_Strength = 1
				DA_Magic_Conductivity = 3
				DA_Electrical_Conductivity = 3
				#DA_Unique = Cindersteel
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 
				DA_own_copper_provinces = { amount = 30 }
				DA_own_damestear_provinces = { amount = 30 }
				OR = {
					NOT = { DA_own_copper_provinces = { amount = 45 } }
					NOT = { DA_own_damestear_provinces = { amount = 45 } }
				}
			}
			DA_apply_Metal = {
				DA_unit = SHIP
				DA_Cost = 1
				DA_Strength = 1
				DA_Magic_Conductivity = 3
				DA_Electrical_Conductivity = 4
				#DA_Unique = Cindersteel
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 
				DA_own_copper_provinces = { amount = 45 }
				DA_own_damestear_provinces = { amount = 45 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = DA_own_45_bonus_tt
			DA_apply_Metal = {
				DA_unit = SHIP
				DA_Cost = 1
				DA_Strength = 2
				DA_Magic_Conductivity = 4
				DA_Electrical_Conductivity = 4
				#DA_Unique = Cindersteel
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = "DA_Metallurgy_events.51.C1"
		highlight = yes
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = DA_Alloy_Enabled.C1
		}
		DA_apply_alloy = {
			DA_unit = SHIP
			DA_alloy_slot = C1
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = "DA_Metallurgy_events.51.C2"

	id = DA_Metallurgy_events.83 # Ironclad design finished

		trigger = { NOT = { culture_group = goblin } }
		picture = DA_forge_finish_eventPicture
	}

	}
